report.answer: During tree insertion, findWildcard() (tree.go:253) detects `:name`/`*catchall` segments and insertChild() (tree.go:288) creates a child node with nType=param (for `:name`) or catchAll (for `*name`), storing the wildcard name (including the leading `:`/`*`) as n.path. During matching, node.getValue() (tree.go:418) walks the tree; on hitting a wildChild it switches on n.nType — for `param` it scans the remaining path up to the next `/` (or path end) as the value and appends a Param{Key: n.path[1:], Value: val} (tree.go: param case, ~line 487-517); for `catchAll` it takes the rest of the path as-is and appends Param{Key: n.path[2:], Value: val} (tree.go: catchAll case, ~line 560-577). Captured params are written into the caller-supplied *Params slice, which handleHTTPRequest assigns to c.Params (gin.go:717) for handler access via c.Param(name).
